name: Aurora
summary: Soft curtains of light drifting across the top of the window, tinted by the theme's accent and positive roles over its background.
preview_alt: Aurora over the default dark theme.
changelog: Asks for 15 frames a second instead of 24: the curtains drift slowly enough that you can't tell, and it costs about 40 % less GPU time a second. Your own frame rate setting still wins.
